# Implementation report — task #824, round 1 (implementer)

**Task:** dispatch repo-branch default falls back to the issue worktree's checked-out branch when invoked from a `main`-pinned checkout (gcp/auto lane only) — closes the #812 failure class (repo-root dispatch silently cloned `main` on GCE; issue-branch scripts absent; workload crashed rc=2).

### (a) What was done

- `scripts/dispatch_issue.py` (+68 lines, plan §4 verbatim):
  - New helper `_git_branch_of(root) -> str | None` — `git -C <root> branch --show-current` (empty output on detached HEAD → `None`; any `OSError`/`SubprocessError` → `None`; 10s timeout).
  - New helper `_warn_if_branch_not_pushed(branch, git_root) -> None` — `git -C <git_root> ls-remote --exit-code origin <branch>` (30s timeout); WARN-and-continue on nonzero/failure, NEVER raises, never blocks the launch. WARN names the branch.
  - New `else:` rung appended to the existing repo-branch `elif` in `_launch_extra_from_args`: when `--repo-branch` is absent, the lane is `{"auto","gcp"}`, and the invoking checkout is on `main` (or unresolvable), resolve the issue worktree via the existing `_issue_worktree_git_root(args.issue)`, take its branch via `_git_branch_of`, and if it is a real non-`main` branch: INFO-log which source won (worktree branch + path), run the pushed-branch guard, set `extra["repo_branch"]`. Precedence preserved: explicit flag > non-main invoking checkout (#535 rung, untouched) > worktree branch (new) > no default. Lane gate `(args.backend or "auto") in {"auto", "gcp"}` untouched; `git_repo_root` threading (#685/#705) untouched; no `backends/` or SLURM edits.
- `tests/test_dispatch_issue_cli.py` (+374 lines net):
  - Rescoped/renamed `test_launch_repo_branch_not_defaulted_when_on_main` → `test_launch_repo_branch_not_defaulted_when_on_main_and_no_worktree` (adds `_issue_worktree_git_root → None` stub — pins the no-worktree case explicitly now that a present worktree DOES default).
  - 10 new tests (plan §5 (a)–(i) + the allowed runpod lane variant): fallback fires from `main` (a) and from unresolvable current branch (i), both asserting the guard was called with `(branch, worktree_root)`; no default when the worktree is on `main` (b) or detached (c), guard not consulted; explicit `--repo-branch` wins with a RAISING `_git_branch_of` stub proving the fallback rung is never consulted (d); non-main invoking checkout wins over the worktree branch (e); no default on explicit `nibi` (f) and explicit `runpod` (f-opt) lanes; guard never-raises contract under `TimeoutExpired` and rc=2 with WARN captured via `caplog` (g); `_git_branch_of` real-git semantics — named branch / detached→None / missing dir→None (h). All launch tests stub `_warn_if_branch_not_pushed` with a recorder so no real `git ls-remote` (network) runs in tests.
